column3: “The people of” explains Jerusalem going into exile.
“Only” is added, and “child” renders a youth.
“Only” is added to the designation of a youth.
“Boiling” interprets the pot blown upon; “toward us” supplies a direction away from the north.
“Clans and kingdoms” coordinates what the Hebrew expresses as clans of kingdoms; “their kings” and “attack” supply the agents and action.
“Get yourself ready” resolves the image of girding the loins.
